skills.description: Live in-app HTML, standalone SVG, and deterministic motion-stage previewer in Antigravity side pane, inline chat, or full-page view with auto-reload, viewport switching, click-to-agent DOM inspection, and frame scrubbing.

readmeMarkdown:
ISCV Live Preview

Live in-app HTML, standalone SVG, and deterministic motion-stage previewer for Antigravity 2.0 (SEP-1865 MCP App) with auto-reload, viewport switching, click-to-agent DOM inspection, and frame scrubbing.

**ISCV Live Preview** turns Antigravity's Side Pane (`aux_pane`), Inline Chat, and Full-Page Sidebar (`global`) into a hardened live web and motion-stage preview studio—replacing external browser context-switching with zero-flash CSS hot-swap, 1-click viewport/aspect scaling (`Fit`, `Desktop`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `1:1`), click-to-agent DOM & live-editable WCAG 2.1 visual inspection (`updateModelContext` + opt-in `Sync to File`), standalone `.svg` element inspection, and automatic `window.seekToFrame(frame, fps)` timeline scrubbing.

| Narrow Side Pane (`460×780`, Stacked Inspector) | Inline Chat Preview Card (`≤ 800 px` Bounded) | | :---: | :---: | | | | --- ## ⚡ TL;DR — Capabilities & Verified Receipts - **4 Core Differentiating Features (Zero External Browser Needed)**: 1. **Targeted Auto Live-Reload**: Watches only the entry directory and served asset folders (`≤ 16` dirs) over same-origin SSE (`0` outer `connectDomains`, `0 / 4` `callServerTool` slots); hot-swaps external `.css` `` tags and inline `
latestReleaseNotes: # ISCV Live Preview v1.0.0 — Initial Antigravity 2.0 MCP App Release First public release of **ISCV Live Preview**, a zero-dependency **live HTML, standalone SVG, and deterministic motion-stage previewer** engineered natively for **Antigravity 2.0 MCP Apps** (Side Pane `aux_pane`, Inline Chat card, and Full-Page `global` sidebar view). ![ISCV Live Preview Light Mode Workbench](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iscvlab/iscv-live-preview/main/docs/images/pane_canopy_motion_light.png) ## Install in 1 Command ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/iscvlab/iscv-live-preview ``` Zero build step or `node_modules/` required at runtime — prebuilt single-file bundles (`bin/server.cjs`, `ui/pane.html`, `ui/inline.html`) live cleanly at the repository root (`7.62%` of the `10 MiB` MCP App bundle cap). ## What's Included in `v1.0.0` - **3 Native Antigravity Surfaces**: Side Pane (`aux_pane`), Full-Page Sidebar (`global`), and bounded Inline Chat cards (`180–660 px`, `≤ 800 px` total) with `5` SEP-1865 MCP tools (`iscv_preview_open`, `iscv_preview_inline`, plus app-only `iscv_preview_list_files`, `iscv_preview_select_file`, `iscv_preview_control`) and full MCP `ToolAnnotations`. - **Targeted Auto Live-Reload**: Non-recursive directory watching (`≤ 16` LRU dirs) over same-origin SSE; zero-flash external `.css` `` hot-swapping, root-URL-rewritten inline `
